name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a natural resource company based in Reno, Nevada, operating a royalty creation, precious-metals streaming, and exploration accelerator business model. The company holds royalty and streaming interests across multiple gold properties in Nevada, including the Lapon Canyon Project (3% NSR) and Olinghouse Project. All projects are at the exploration stage within one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions.
